title: Sakura Tsuushin
overview:
The most important person was right beside me. So why didn't I notice...

The hugely popular comic "Sakura Tsuushin," serialized in "Weekly Young Sunday" (Shogakukan), has become a game. You become the hero, Touma Inaba, meet Urara Kasuga, and then encounter all kinds of incidents. An adult adventure game where you can enjoy numerous scenario developments and multiple endings. The original work is by popular author U-Jin. The animated movies that appear during the game further heighten the fun of "Sakura Tsuushin." It is also packed with extras you can casually enjoy outside the main game, such as mini-games and a BGM listening mode.

一番大切な人は俺のそばにいた。なのに何で気づかなかったんだろう…。

「週刊ヤングサンデー」（小学館）で連載中の大人気コミック「桜通信」が、ゲームになった。あなたは主人公の因幡冬馬になって春日麗と出逢い、その後、さまざまな事件に遭遇していきます。数々のシナリオ展開とマルチエンディングが楽しめる大人のアドベンチャーゲーム。原作は、人気作家「遊人」氏。ゲーム中に現れるアニメーションムービーも「桜通信」の楽しさをいっそう盛り上げてくれます。ミニゲームやBGM鑑賞モードなど、ゲーム本編以外に気軽に楽しめる要素も充実。
